title: Jacobs appoints Richard “Ric” Phillips to Board of Directors
summary: Jacobs today announced the appointment of Richard “Ric” Phillips to its Board of Directors, effective December 1, 2026.
body_markdown:
DALLAS –


[Jacobs](http://www.jacobs.com/) (NYSE: J) today announced the appointment of Richard “Ric” Phillips to its Board of Directors, effective December 1, 2026. With Phillips’ appointment, the Jacobs Board will comprise 10 directors, nine of whom are independent.


Phillips has served as chief executive officer and a director of Kimball Electronics, Inc. (Nasdaq: KE), a global manufacturing solutions provider, since 2023. He previously served as president and chief executive officer of Elkay Manufacturing Company, and as president and chief executive officer of Essendant, Inc., a Fortune 500 wholesale distributor. Earlier in his career, he spent 14 years at McKinsey & Company, where he was elected partner and co-led the firm’s Pharmaceutical and Medical Products Operations practice. He began his career at Baxter Healthcare Corporation.


Over the course of his career, Phillips has served on the board of The Greenheck Group, Elkay Manufacturing Company, Essendant, Inc. and Follett Corporation, as well as nonprofit boards including Chicagoland Habitat for Humanity and Catholic Charities, Diocese of Joliet. He holds a Master of Management degree from Northwestern University’s Kellogg School of Management and a Bachelor of Science degree in Finance from Indiana University Bloomington.


**Jacobs Chair and Chief Executive Officer Bob Pragada said:** “Ric is a proven public company CEO whose career has been defined by leading transformation, driving growth and delivering operational excellence across a range of industries. His experience as both a seasoned operator and a strategic advisor, combined with his board service across public and private companies, will bring valuable perspective as we continue to deliver for our clients and advance our strategy. We are delighted to welcome Ric to the Jacobs Board.”


At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow – delivering outcomes and solutions for the world’s most complex challenges. With approximately $12 billion in annual revenue and a team of approximately 47,000, we provide end-to-end services in advanced manufacturing, cities & places, energy, environmental, life sciences, transportation and water.
